name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Native checkbox with an optional label and description, custom styled without JavaScript.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text next to the box, linked through for/id.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text below the label, linked through aria-describedby.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked / v-model
props.description: Checked state. Blade uses the checked attribute, React checked or defaultChecked, Vue v-model.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the checkbox and dims the label.

a11y: Uses a native checkbox input, so Space toggles it and screen readers announce its state.
The label is linked through for and id, so clicking the label toggles the box too.
The check icon is decorative (aria-hidden), the visual state follows :checked.

ai.whenToUse: Consent or a yes/no choice that only applies after the form is submitted, or several independent options.
rules: Use Switch for settings that apply immediately
Always set a label or aria-label

id.description: Kotak centang native dengan label dan deskripsi opsional, tampilan kustom tanpa JavaScript.

props.label: Teks label di samping kotak, terhubung lewat for/id.
props.description: Teks penjelas di bawah label, dihubungkan lewat aria-describedby.
props.checked / defaultChecked / v-model: Status centang. Blade memakai atribut checked, React checked atau defaultChecked, Vue v-model.
props.id: Id input. Dibuat otomatis kalau kosong.

a11y: Memakai input type checkbox native, jadi Spasi mencentang dan status dibacakan screen reader.
Label terhubung lewat for dan id sehingga mengklik label ikut mencentang.
Ikon centang hanya dekorasi (aria-hidden), status visual mengikuti :checked.

ai.whenToUse: Persetujuan atau pilihan ya/tidak yang baru berlaku setelah form dikirim, atau beberapa pilihan bebas.
rules: Pakai Switch untuk pengaturan yang langsung berlaku
